account_id.description: The chart account it posts to: one marked a money account, in its currency.

cardholder.description: A card: its holder, whose My claims shows its lines to complete with a receipt and a category (FR-AP-18).

closed_on.description: The day it closed: a closed account takes no import.

freshness.description: How up to date its data is (FR-BNK-16).

gaps.description: getMoneyAccount only: the breaks in its balance chain not yet resolved.

identifier.description: The last four characters of what statements name it by (an account number, an IBAN or a provider's balance ID); the rest is never shown (SEC-15).

kind.description: What kind of money account it is.

payment_file.description: The file a payment batch paying from it gives when released (FR-BNK-12, rev 0.157): payment-list, the payment list keyed into any bank (the default); wise-batch, Wise's batch payment file; dbs-uff, DBS IDEAL's UFF. A batch released before a change keeps its file.

payment_files.description: Every payment file, whether it may be set to it now and, when not, why: a bank's own file only for an account at that bank, and only once Fyniq writes it.

provider.description: The bank or provider Fyniq recognises it as: its statement connector's when it syncs through one (wise, airwallex), else its institution matched by name against Fyniq's list (dbs, ocbc, uob, standard-chartered, hsbc, citibank, maybank, cimb, bank-of-china, icbc, rhb, gxs, trust, maribank, anext, aspire, airwallex, wise). Absent: another bank. It decides which payment files it may give (FR-BNK-12).

source.description: Where its data comes from now; absent while its statements are uploaded as files.

sources.description: getMoneyAccount only: every source it has had, earliest first (UC-BNK-03).

waiting.description: Its lines waiting in the queue: unreconciled, possible duplicates and in suspense.
